verdict.rationale: The Admin API is documented as providing 'comprehensive programmatic access to all Unleash resources', and a runtime probe confirms a real create-and-evaluate flag loop via the Admin/Client APIs with no UI involved, showing core flag management is fully API-driven. However, some UI-centric workflows (e.g., change request approval flows, RBAC/SSO configuration, impact-metrics dashboards) are not shown to have full API parity in the evidence. missing for 10: explicit documentation/proof that change-request approvals, RBAC/SSO setup, and impact-metrics automation can be fully performed via API rather than just referenced conceptually.
